what: Todd Fritzen and Wetzel Storage LLC ask for four variances to put battery energy storage equipment much closer to the lot lines than the industrial zone allows: 10.3 feet from Wetzel Road instead of 200, 20 feet from Maltlage Drive instead of 50, 20 feet on the side instead of 25, and 10.3 feet instead of 115 under the highway overlay rule.
where: 4664 Wetzel Road, Liverpool, NY 13090 (Tax Map 087.-01-12.0), Industrial 1 (I-1) zone
next: The board can grant, deny or set conditions. The county planning board report was requested Sep 24 and had not come back when the agenda was printed.
line: Battery storage gear at 4664 Wetzel Rd needs setback waivers: hearing
quote: The requested variances include a reduction in the front yard setback along Wetzel Road from 200 feet to 10.3 feet, a reduction in the front yard setback along Maltlage Drive from 50 feet to 20 feet, a reduction in the side yard setback from 25 feet to 20 feet, and a reduction in Highway Overlay Type C setback from 115 feet to 10.3 feet for the development of BESS equipment.
source_url: https://townofclayny.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/Zoning%20Board%20Agenda%20-%20October%2012%2C%202026.pdf

what: Resolution 68-2026 adopts Local Law No. 5 of 2026, which adds a Battery Energy Storage System Law (new Chapter 58) to the town code and changes the zoning chapter (165) to match. The law sets rules on where battery storage can go and how it is built and run, with Tier 1 (up to 600 kWh) and Tier 2 (over 600 kWh) systems.
next: If adopted, the Town Clerk files the law with the NY Secretary of State, publishes an abstract in the official newspaper and posts it on the town sign board.
history: Public hearing held Sep 8, 2026, 6:00 pm, Geneva Town Hall, 3750 County Road 6 (from the resolution). Our Sep 8 agenda record also carried the SEQR finding (Res. 67-2026) and this same adoption resolution (Res. 68-2026).
line: Final vote on Geneva's battery storage law (Local Law No. 5)
quote: 11. RESOLUTION NO. 68-2026 — Adopting Local Law No. 5 of 2026, Battery Energy Storage Systems.
source_url: https://townofgenevany.gov/Documents/Departments and Services/Agendas & Minutes/Town Board Meeting Agendas/2026.10.13 Town Board Meeting Agenda.pdf
